news.headline: No. 16 Oregon keeps CFP hopes alive with win over Michigan
news.description: Dylan Raiola threw for 341 yards and four touchdowns, and No. 16 Oregon kept its slim chances for a spot in the College Football Playoff alive with a victory over struggling Michigan on Saturday.

news.headline: Wake Forest's post-blowout jab at SMU tops college football Week 11 trolls
news.description: Wake Forest dominated SMU on the gridiron Saturday -- and added insult to injury after the game.

news.headline: Grant Wilson delivers as Indiana boosts CFP, Big Ten hopes with win vs. USC
news.description: With Grant Wilson filling in at quarterback, No. 9 Indiana ramped up its offensive attack against USC and scored its best win of the season Saturday.

news.headline: Watch best moments and top plays live from Week 11
Darian Mensah dices up ex-team Duke as Miami rebounds from first loss
news.description: Miami quarterback Darian Mensah diced up his former team Saturday, finishing with 382 yards and a touchdown in the 36-25 victory over Duke.

news.headline: Wake Forest strengthens CFP case with 'statement' win at SMU
news.description: No. 13 Wake Forest made a statement to the College Football Playoff selection committee with a 49-7 blowout of SMU on Saturday.

news.headline: Vols lose top receiver Matthews to knee injury vs. Texas A&M
news.description: Tennessee leading receiver Mike Matthews suffered a right knee injury in the second quarter of Saturday's game at Texas A&M.

news.headline: Georgia commit, DL Marcellus Young Casario died after 'sudden medical emergency'
news.description: Marcellus Young Casario, a Georgia football commit, died Friday after experiencing a "sudden medical emergency," according to his high school.

news.headline: Oklahoma AD rips Ole Miss, SEC; Rebels defend travel effort
news.description: Oklahoma AD Roger Denny ripped the SEC and Ole Miss for the "inexplicable" decision to move its game to Sunday, while the Rebels defended their travel efforts.

news.headline: Clemson QB Reynolds to have MRI on knee; backup Vizzina (ankle) also hurt
news.description: Clemson quarterback Tait Reynolds is having an MRI on his injured knee, and backup Christopher Vizzina was sent to the hospital to evaluate his ankle.

wiki.title: Trevor Lauck
wiki.intro: Trevor Lauck (born September 27, 2004) is an American college football offensive tackle for the Iowa Hawkeyes.
